set.body:
Outcome

Replace runtime Response narrowing and string metrics with predictive scientific types.

Acceptance

- Categorical target, class axis, positive-class policy, uncalibrated score, calibrated probability, prediction, and measure are distinct.
- Invalid class coverage and target alignment fail at binding.
- Accuracy, balanced accuracy, confusion matrix, and any AUC variant state their exact estimand.
- Results retain sample and class ordering.
set.title: P4A.3: define categorical targets, class scores, predictions, and measures
